description.summary: lenses set into the liquid glass of layer surfaces

protocol.description: mango draws liquid glass under the layer surfaces that a layer rule gives glass (glass:1). A lens is a second glass set into that glass: a rounded box with its own tint and a narrow rim, so the backdrop bends where the two glasses meet. A shell uses one to mark the chosen row of a list.

interface.name: mango_glass_lens_manager_v1
interface.description: The global through which a client gets a lens for a surface.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Lenses made through the manager stay.

request.name: get_lens

description.summary: get the lens of a surface

request.description: Makes the lens for a surface's glass. It shows nothing until set_box. The lens only shows on a layer surface that mango gives glass.

entry.name: lens_exists
entry.summary: the surface has a lens already

interface.name: mango_glass_lens_v1

description.summary: a lens set into a surface's glass

interface.description: Its box and clip are double-buffered state of the surface: they apply on the surface's next wl_surface.commit, with the content drawn for them. When the surface is destroyed, the lens does nothing anymore.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Removes the lens from the glass at once.

request.name: set_box
request.description: Places the lens, in the surface's coordinates, with rounded corners of the given radius. A width or height of 0 hides it.

request.name: set_clip

description.summary: show the lens only inside a box

request.description: Cuts the lens off outside this box, in the surface's coordinates, so that it can scroll out of view with what it marks. A width or height of 0 removes the clip.
